Thank you so much for your 5-star review!

I'm really glad that Kick/Bass Scope has been useful in your workflow!

I developed the entire plugin myself as an independent developer under Code Chaos Audio. 
Alongside audio software development, I also offer professional online mastering services through two specialized platforms:

Code Chaos Audio – Specialized in Psytrance (all subgenres) and other electronic music.
https://codechaos-official.de

Polished Media – Specialized in Metal, Hardcore, Djent, Gothic and other heavy and dark music genres.
https://polished.media

I'm also introducing a free, no-obligation mix audit as an entry point for artists who want professional feedback on their mixes before booking a mastering service.

Thanks again for supporting independent audio development!

Best regards,  
Tim  
Code Chaos Audio / Polished Media

bewertungen.text: Generally, since I mostly work with electronic arrangements, I haven't had many phase issues. However, after recording some organic instruments in the low-frequency range, I wasn't entirely sure about the phase alignment, so I decided to use this plugin. It turned out to be really helpful. I'd like to thank everyone involved in creating it! (TEST)
